Description

Fleet Storage Filter lets you easily search through the hundreds of ships you hoarded at your colonies.

Showcase

Installation/Uninstallation

To install Fleet Storage Filter, just unzip the downloaded archive into Starsector mods folder.

Fleet Storage Filter can be safely added and removed from existing save games.
